## Employee Onboarding Workflow
One new-hire record creates every onboarding task with an owner and a deadline, and chases the ones running late.

POST a new hire from your HR form (name, role, department, manager, start_date, remote). Builds the full onboarding task list with owners and business-day due dates, adds it to a tracker sheet, and emails the new hire a welcome note.

**Try it:** click *Test workflow* to run on the sample data. Then connect your credentials on the output nodes and activate.

Code and docs: github.com/Princewill106/employee-onboarding-workflow
